plugins.name: case-study
plugins.description: Strengthen an existing portfolio case study by interviewing you about it one question at a time, then trimming and correcting your own words — real proof, clear arcs, an ownership audit for the parts you undersold, and zero fabricated facts. Every gap becomes a question, never a placeholder. Works on a file, a URL, or pasted text.

plugins.name: design-goals
plugins.description: Interview-driven goal-setting and performance-review prep for designers: map your evidence to a behavioural bar and pick the moves that close the gaps.

plugins.name: field-notes
plugins.description: Keep field notes on a project — a skill plus capture hooks that log the why behind your decisions, live, for a future blog post, case study, or retro.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Three writing standards, one per genre. `conversation-prose` governs an agent's replies, `documentation-prose` governs skills and READMEs and specs, and `published-prose` governs text going out under an author's own name. Ships the per-turn checklist hook that keeps the conversation standard applied over a long session.

plugins.name: impact-report
plugins.description: Turn one initiative you owned into a short, shareable impact report.
